why: ChatGPT's answer does make the camera a second item: it tells the shopper to make sure the package includes the rear camera rather than merely supporting a camera input, and to check that the screen switches to the rear view automatically in reverse. But it carded two all-in-one products (ESSGOO 10.26" with backup camera at $109 and Easyonlife 10.26" with dash cam and backup camera at $79.99), because screen-plus-camera is normally sold as one SKU, so the set fails the uncarded test and the page should compare those all-in-one models and recommend one.
